## DefaultPlayerEntityController.localPredictionMotionBasisVelocity property

Owner-only motion basis velocity used by the client prediction path.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get localPredictionMotionBasisVelocity(): Vector3Like;
```

## Remarks

This combines platform and external impulse motion, which are not derivable from deterministic input replay alone on the client.
